items.title: John Batiste "Bat" Mosley Interview, 1961-09-23
items.q: And Bill, he was pretty good too. Bill Matthews.

ctx.x: Were there any other drummers that were outstanding that you can remember when you were a boy that you liked especially?
Well, I liked it. Bebe. Matthews. Yeah, he was a drummer too. I liked it him. And Bill, he was pretty good too. Bill Matthews.
Bebe, best mostly in the dance band or on the street? What was he famous for?
